programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - I Shall Never Look Back'. The war enters its third year with battlefields in Eastern Europe, North Africa and the Asia/Pacific. The Battle of Midway, a battle with irreversible consequences, is a victory for the USA.

programme.title: Hitler's Handmaidens
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Female Fuhrers'. A look at the women surrounding Hitler once he came to power, and how they were held up as the Aryan Ideal to strive for once the Nazi dictator approved of their positions.

programme.title: Kevin Costner's The West
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - The Fetterman Fight'. When Civil War veteran Col. Henry Carrington takes command of Fort Phil Kearny in Northern Wyoming, he never expects to face such a ferocious enemy as Red Cloud's band of Lakota Sioux.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - The King's Mask, The Nazi Plate And The Stonehenge Drums'. Agamemnon is one of the greatest figures in Greek literature - the king who lays siege to the city of Troy.

programme.title: Storage Hunters
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Cash Wars'. Brandon and Lori go to war over a record producer's storage unit and unearth a priceless piece of rock and roll history. Then, Jesse one ups the competition for a locker with a multi-thousand dollar payout.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Most Wanted
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Parent 'Hood''. Beth receives some devastating news. Leland recruits Dog and the team to track down two fugitives in Hawaii while he takes care of business on the Mainland.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Most Wanted
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Saving Jamie'. With Beth and the rest of the team busy searching for a new office in Hawaii, Dog and David go to Las Vegas and find that it isn't called Sin City for nothing.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: 'S5/E2'. Derek heads to Warrington to collect a posse of scooters, a Daimler and a teardrop caravan. Some old Cortinas turn up - and the Mathewsons try to sell a mini locomotive.

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
programme.desc: 'S7/E1 - Area 51'. Hidden in the Nevada desert, a top-secret military base remains one of the most heavily restricted sites in the United States. Since the 1950s, speculation has swirled about its true purpose.

programme.title: Queens Of Ancient Egypt
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Cleopatra's Daughter'. Cleopatra Selene, daughter of Mark Antony and Cleopatra VII. Cleopatra's daughter looked destined for death or obscurity. But she recovered her fortunes to become one of Africa's greatest queens.

programme.title: Paranormal: Caught On Camera
programme.desc: 'S8/E3 - The Phantom Hand Of Leicester And More!'. A man in Leicester, England, is startled in his home by a spiritual manifestation. Next, a paranormal investigator in Sussex, England, captures a shadowy figure...

programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War

programme.title: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
